def dfs(node, parent, pres)
  children = [] of Tuple(BigRational, BigRational)
  count = 0_i64
  pres[node].each do |pre|
    next if pre == parent
    c_count, c_exp, c_pot = dfs(pre, parent, pres)
    count += c_count
    children << {c_exp, c_pot}
  end

  if children.size == 0
    {
      1,
      BigRational.new(0, 1),
      BigRational.new(0, 1),
    }
  else
    expectation = BigRational.new(1, 2)
    potential = BigRational.new(1.to_big_i << count - 1, 1.to_big_i << count)

    children.each do |(c_exp, c_pot)|
      expectation += c_pot / 2
      expectation += c_exp
      potential += c_pot / 2
    end

    {
      count + 1,
      expectation,
      potential,
    }
  end
end

module mod_unweighted_graph
  implicit none

  type t_list
    integer, allocatable :: at(:)
  end type

  type unweighted_graph
    type(t_list), allocatable :: list(:)
  contains
    procedure :: is_bipartite => is_bipartite
    procedure :: get_cycle => get_cycle
    procedure :: topological_sort => topological_sort
    procedure :: find_centroids => find_centroids
  end type

  type unweighted_graph_list
    type(unweighted_graph), allocatable :: graphs(:)
  end type

  interface unweighted_graph
    module procedure :: newug0
  end interface unweighted_graph

contains

  type(unweighted_graph) function newug0(n, m, a, b, undirected) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, m, a(:), b(:)
    logical, optional, intent(in) :: undirected
    logical :: u
    integer :: c(n), i
    u = merge(undirected, .true., present(undirected))
    c = 0
    do i = 1, m
      c(a(i)) = c(a(i)) + 1
      if (u) c(b(i)) = c(b(i)) + 1
    end do
    allocate(res%list(n))
    do i = 1, n
      allocate(res%list(i)%at(c(i)))
    end do
    do i = m, 1, -1
      res%list(a(i))%at(c(a(i))) = b(i)
      c(a(i)) = c(a(i)) - 1
      if (u) then
        res%list(b(i))%at(c(b(i))) = a(i)
        c(b(i)) = c(b(i)) - 1
      end if
    end do
  end

  logical function is_bipartite(this) result(res)
    class(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    integer(1) :: color(size(this%list))
    integer :: i
    color = 0_1
    color(1) = 1_1
    res = ibdfs(this, color, 1)
  end

  recursive logical function ibdfs(this, color, u) result(res)
    type(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    integer(1), intent(inout) :: color(:)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    integer :: i, v
    do i = 1, size(this%list(u)%at)
      v = this%list(u)%at(i)
      if (color(v) == color(u)) then
        res = .false.; return
      end if
      if (color(v) == 0_1) then
        color(v) = -color(u)
        if (.not.ibdfs(this, color, v)) then
          res = .false.; return
        end if
      end if
    end do
    res = .true.
  end

  function get_cycle(this) result(res)
    class(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    integer :: res(size(this%list) + 1), idx, pos, i
    logical :: used(size(this%list)), finished(size(this%list))
    used = .false.
    finished = .false.
    idx = 0
    pos = -1
    call gcdfs(this, used, finished, 1, -1, res, idx, pos)
    do i = 1, idx
      if (res(i) == pos) then
        res(1:idx - i + 1) = res(i:idx)
        idx = idx - i + 1
      end if
    end do
    res(idx + 1:size(this%list) + 1) = -1
    res(size(this%list) + 1) = idx
  end

  recursive subroutine gcdfs(this, used, finished, u, p, stack, idx, pos)
    type(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    logical, intent(inout) :: used(:), finished(:)
    integer, intent(in) :: u, p
    integer, intent(inout) :: stack(:), idx, pos
    integer :: i, v
    used(u) = .true.
    idx = idx + 1
    stack(idx) = u
    do i = 1, size(this%list(u)%at)
      v = this%list(u)%at(i)
      if (v == p) cycle
      if (finished(v)) cycle
      if (used(v)) then
        pos = v; return
      end if
      call gcdfs(this, used, finished, v, u, stack, idx, pos)
      if (pos > 0) return
    end do
    idx = idx - 1
    finished(u) = .true.
  end

  function topological_sort(this) result(res)
    class(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    integer :: res(size(this%list)), idx, i
    logical :: used(size(this%list))
    used = .false.
    idx = size(this%list)
    do i = 1, size(this%list)
      if (used(i)) cycle
      call tsdfs(this, used, i, res, idx)
    end do
  end

  recursive subroutine tsdfs(this, used, u, sorted, idx)
    type(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    logical, intent(inout) :: used(:)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    integer, intent(inout) :: sorted(:), idx
    integer :: i, v
    used(u) = .true.
    do i = 1, size(this%list(u)%at)
      v = this%list(u)%at(i)
      if (used(v)) cycle
      call tsdfs(this, used, v, sorted, idx)
    end do
    sorted(idx) = u
    idx = idx - 1
  end

  function find_centroids(this) result(res)
    class(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    integer :: sizes(size(this%list))
    integer :: res(3), idx, i
    res = -1
    idx = 0
    call fcdfs(this, sizes, 1, -1, res, idx)
    res(3) = idx
  end

  recursive subroutine fcdfs(this, sizes, u, p, centroids, idx)
    type(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: u, p
    integer, intent(inout) :: sizes(:), centroids(:), idx
    integer :: i, v
    logical :: found
    found = .true.
    sizes(u) = 1
    do i = 1, size(this%list(u)%at)
      v = this%list(u)%at(i)
      if (v == p) cycle
      call fcdfs(this, sizes, v, u, centroids, idx)
      if (sizes(v) > size(this%list) / 2) found = .false.
      sizes(u) = sizes(u) + sizes(v)
    end do
    if (size(this%list) - sizes(u) > size(this%list) / 2) found = .false.
    if (found) then
      idx = idx + 1
      centroids(idx) = u
    end if
  end

  type(unweighted_graph_list) function strongly_connected_components(n, m, a, b) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, m, a(:), b(:)
    type(unweighted_graph) :: g
    integer :: order(n), number(n), idx, i, j
    logical :: used(n)
    integer :: x(m, 2), y(m, 2), cnt(2)
    g = newug0(n, m, a, b, .false.)
    used = .false.
    idx = n
    do i = 1, n
      if (used(i)) cycle
      call sccdfs1(g, used, i, order, idx)
    end do
    g = newug0(n, m, b, a, .false.)
    number = -1
    idx = 0
    do i = 1, n
      if (number(order(i)) > 0) cycle
      idx = idx + 1
      call sccdfs2(g, order(i), number, idx)
    end do
    cnt = 0
    do i = 1, m
      j = merge(2, 1, number(a(i)) == number(b(i)))
      cnt(j) = cnt(j) + 1
      x(cnt(j), j) = a(i)
      y(cnt(j), j) = b(i)
    end do
    call remove_multiedge(cnt(1), x(:, 1), y(:, 1))
    allocate(res%graphs(3))
    do i = 1, 2
      res%graphs(i) = newug0(n, cnt(i), x(:, i), y(:, i), .false.)
    end do
    allocate(res%graphs(3)%list(1))
    allocate(res%graphs(3)%list(1)%at(n))
    res%graphs(3)%list(1)%at = number
  end

  recursive subroutine sccdfs1(this, used, u, order, idx)
    type(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    logical, intent(inout) :: used(:)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    integer, intent(inout) :: order(:), idx
    integer :: i, v
    used(u) = .true.
    do i = 1, size(this%list(u)%at)
      v = this%list(u)%at(i)
      if (used(v)) cycle
      call sccdfs1(this, used, v, order, idx)
    end do
    idx = idx - 1
    order(idx) = u
  end

  recursive subroutine sccdfs2(this, u, number, idx)
    type(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: u, idx
    integer, intent(inout) :: number(:)
    integer :: i, v
    number(u) = idx
    do i = 1, size(this%list(u)%at)
      v = this%list(u)%at(i)
      if (number(v) > 0) cycle
      call sccdfs2(this, v, number, idx)
    end do
  end

  subroutine remove_multiedge(m, a, b)
    integer, intent(inout) :: m, a(:), b(:)
    integer :: i, x(2, size(a)), idx
    do i = 1, m
      x(1, i) = a(i)
      x(2, i) = b(i)
    end do
    call merge_sort(x(1:2, 1:m))
    a(1) = x(1, 1)
    b(1) = x(2, 1)
    idx = 1
    do i = 2, m
      if (a(idx) == x(1, i) .and. b(idx) == x(2, i)) cycle
      idx = idx + 1
      a(idx) = x(1, i)
      b(idx) = x(2, i)
    end do
    m = idx
  end

  subroutine merge_sort(a)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a(:, :)
    integer :: n, m, l, i, u, j
    n = size(a,1)
    m = n
    l = 1
    do while (m > 1)
      do i = 1, m / 2
        u = min(2 * i * l, n)
        j = 2 * (i - 1) * l + 1
        call merger(a(j:j + l - 1, :), a(j + l:u, :))
      end do
      l = 2 * l
      m = (m + 1) / 2
    end do
  end

  subroutine merger(a1, a2)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a1(:, :), a2(:, :)
    integer :: a(size(a1, 1) + size(a2, 1), size(a1, 2))
    integer :: i1, i2, n1, n2
    i1 = 1
    i2 = 1
    n1 = size(a1, 1)
    n2 = size(a2, 1)
    do while (i1 <= n1 .and. i2 <= n2)
      if (a1(i1, 1) < a2(i2, 1) .or. &
        (a1(i1, 1) == a2(i2, 1) .and. a1(i1, 2) <= a2(i2, 2))) then
        a(i1 + i2 - 1, :) = a1(i1, :)
        i1 = i1 + 1
      else
        a(i1 + i2 - 1, :) = a2(i2, :)
        i2 = i2 + 1
       end if
    end do
    if (i1 <= n1) then
      a(i1 + i2 - 1:n1 + n2, :) = a1(i1:n1, :)
    else
      a(i1 + i2 - 1:n1 + n2, :) = a2(i2:n2, :)
    end if
    a1 = a(1:n1, :)
    a2 = a(n1 + 1:n1 + n2, :)
  end

end module mod_unweighted_graph
program surrounded_nodes
  use mod_unweighted_graph
  implicit none
  integer(8), parameter :: modu = 1000000007, half = (modu + 1) / 2
  integer :: n, i
  integer, dimension(200000) :: a = 0, b = 0
  integer(8) :: x = 0, pow(0:200000) = 0
  type(unweighted_graph) :: t
  read(*,*) n
  pow(0) = 1
  do i = 1, n
    pow(i) = mod(pow(i - 1) * half, modu)
  end do
  do i = 1, n - 1
    read(*,*) a(i), b(i)
  end do
  t = unweighted_graph(n, n - 1, a, b)
  i = dfs(t, 1, -1)
  write(*,'(i0)') x
contains
  recursive integer function dfs(this, v, p) result(res)
    type(unweighted_graph), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: v, p
    integer :: i, u, s, tmp
    integer(8) :: y
    y = half
    res = 1
    s = size(this%list(v)%at)
    do i = 1, s
      u = this%list(v)%at(i)
      if (u == p) cycle
      tmp = dfs(this, u, v)
      y = modulo(y - pow(n - tmp), modu)
      res = res + tmp
    end do
    if (res /= n) y = modulo(y - pow(res), modu)
    y = mod(y + pow(n) * (s - 1), modu)
    x = mod(x + y, modu)
  end
end program surrounded_nodes

local mod = 1000000007
local mfl = math.floor

-- 10^9 + 7 only
-- (31623^2) % 1000000007 = 14122
local function bmul(x, y)
  local x0, y0 = x % 31623, y % 31623
  local x1, y1 = mfl(x / 31623), mfl(y / 31623)
  return (x1 * y1 * 14122 + (x1 * y0 + x0 * y1) * 31623 + x0 * y0) % mod
end

local function badd(x, y)
  return (x + y) % mod
end

local function bsub(x, y)
  return x < y and x - y + mod or x - y
end

local function modpow(src, pow)
  local res = 1
  while 0 < pow do
    if pow % 2 == 1 then
      res = bmul(res, src)
      pow = pow - 1
    end
    src = bmul(src, src)
    pow = mfl(pow / 2)
  end
  return res
end

local function modinv(src)
  return modpow(src, mod - 2)
end

newtype Rem = Rem {unRem :: RemRep} deriving Eq
instance Num Rem where
  Rem x - Rem y = Rem $ x-y + if x >= y then 0 else modulus
  negate (Rem x) = Rem $ modulus - x
  x + y = x - (-y)
  fromInteger x = Rem $ fromInteger (x `mod` MODULUS)
  Rem x * Rem y = Rem $ (x * y) `rem` modulus
  abs = id
  signum (Rem 0) = Rem 0
  signum _ = Rem 1

instance Show Rem where
  showsPrec = coerce (showsPrec :: Int -> RemRep -> ShowS)


{-# SPECIALIZE extEuc :: RemRep -> RemRep -> (RemRep,RemRep,RemRep) #-}
{-# INLINE extEuc #-}
extEuc :: (Integral a) => a -> a -> (a,a,a)
extEuc x0 y0
  = loop (signum x0) 0 (abs x0) 0 (signum y0) (abs y0)
  where
    loop !a !b !x !c !d 0 = (a,b,x)
    loop !a !b !x !c !d !y
      = loop c d y (a - q*c) (b - q*d) z
      where
        (q,z) = x `quotRem` y

{-# SPECIALIZE invMod :: RemRep -> RemRep -> Maybe RemRep #-}
{-# INLINE invMod #-}
invMod :: (Integral a) => a -> a -> Maybe a
invMod x m
  | g == 1 = Just r'
  | otherwise = Nothing
  where
    (_,r,g) = extEuc m x
    r' = r `mod` m

instance Fractional Rem where
  recip (Rem x) = Rem $ fromJust $ invMod x modulus
  fromRational p = fromInteger (numerator p) / fromInteger (denominator p)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine

  let cods = V.create $ do
        cods <- VM.replicate n []
        VU.forM_ edges $ \ (!a,!b) -> do
          !as <- VM.read cods a
          VM.write cods a $! b:as
          !bs <- VM.read cods b
          VM.write cods b $! a:bs
        return cods
  -- print cods
  print $ snd $ query n cods
  return ()

query :: Int -> V.Vector [Int] -> (Int,Rem)
query n vec = go (-1) 0
  where
    go par this = (1 + totChilds,
                   sum exs
                   + recip2* (1-recip2 ^ totChilds
                              - sum
                                 (map (\c -> recip2 ^ (n-1-c)
                                             - recip2 ^ (n-1)) childss)))
      where
        (!childss,!exs)
          = unzip $ map (go this) $ filter (/= par) $ vec V.! this
        totChilds = sum childss

recip2 = recip (Rem 2)

function abmp(a,b,p)
	if b == 0
		1
	elseif b%2 == 0
		k = abmp(a,div(b,2),p)
		(k*k)%p
	else
		(a*abmp(a,b-1,p))%p
	end
end
function binarr(n,p)
	z = 1
	for i in 1:n
		z = z*i%p
	end
	fac = Array{Int}(n+1)
	inv = Array{Int}(n+1)
	inv[n+1] = abmp(z,p-2,p)
	for i in 0:n-1
		inv[n-i] = (inv[n+1-i]*(n-i))%p
	end
	for i in 0:n
		fac[i+1] = (((z*inv[i+1])%p)*inv[n+1-i])%p
	end
	fac
end

function euc(a,m)
	b = m
	x = 1
	u = 0
	while b>0
		q = div(a,b)
		tmp = u
		u = x-q*u
		x = tmp
		tmp = b
		b = a-q*b
		a = tmp
	end
	x<0?x+abs(m):x
end

;; F - Surrounded Nodes

(defparameter *modulus* (+ (expt 10 9) 7))

(defun main ()
  (let* ((N (read))  ; 頂点数
         (tree (read-tree N)))
    (princ (solve N tree))

; 自分が白: 2^(N - 1)
; (b1) 隣接する部分グラフがすべて白: 1
; (b2) 隣接する部分グラフのちょうど一つGに黒が含まれる: 2^size(G) - 1
; 自分がSに含まれる白頂点である確率:
; (2^(N - 1) - 1 - sum_G (2^size(G) - 1))/2^N
; 全頂点の合計:
; (N * 2^(N - 1) - N - (sum_G 2^size(G)) + 2 * (N - 1))/2^N

(defun solve (N tree)
  (destructuring-bind
    ; 各頂点の親と各部分木の頂点数
    (parent subtree-size) (make-rooted-tree 0 tree)
    (let* ((subgraph-size ; 部分グラフの頂点数のリスト
             (loop for v below N append ; 各頂点
               (loop for next in (aref tree v) collect ; vの隣接頂点
                 ; nextの向こう側の部分グラフの頂点数
                 (if (eql next (aref parent v)) ; vの親?
                     (- N (aref subtree-size v))
                     (aref subtree-size next)))))
           (numerator
             (+ (* N (mod-expt-2 (1- N)))
                N -2
                (- *modulus*
                   (reduce #'+ (mapcar #'mod-expt-2 subgraph-size))))))

    ; (2^N) * z == numerator mod *modulus* であるz
    ; *modulus*が素数なので 2^(*modulus* - 1) == 1 mod *modulus*
    (mod (* numerator (mod-expt-2 (- *modulus* 1 N))) *modulus*))))

(defun mod-expt-2 (p)
  "(mod (expt 2 p) *modulus*)を速く計算"
  (mod (reduce #'*
         (loop for i = p then (ash i -1) while (plusp i)
               for e = 2 then (mod (* e e) *modulus*)
               when (oddp i)
               collect e))
       *modulus*))

(defun make-rooted-tree (root tree)
  "頂点rootを根としてtreeの各頂点の親を決める. 部分木の大きさも計算する."
  (let* ((N (array-dimension tree 0)) ; 頂点数
         (parent (make-array N :initial-element nil)) ; 親
         (subtree-size (make-array N :initial-element nil))) ; 部分木の頂点数
    (labels
      ((dfs (stack)
         (when stack
           (let ((v (pop stack)))
             (if (aref subtree-size v)
               ; 帰りがけ
               (loop for next in (aref tree v) ; vの隣接頂点
                 unless (eql next (aref parent v)) ; 親以外
                   do (incf (aref subtree-size v)
                            (aref subtree-size next)))
               ; 行きがけ
               (loop
                 initially (push v stack) ; 帰りがけ用に残す
                           (setf (aref subtree-size v) 1)
                 for next in (aref tree v) ; vの隣接頂点
                 unless (eql next (aref parent v)) ; 親以外
                   do (push next stack)
                      (setf (aref parent next) v))))
           (dfs stack))))
      (dfs (list root))
      (list parent subtree-size))))

(defun read-tree (N)
  "N頂点の木をreadして作る. 頂点番号は0〜N-1"
  (let ((tree (make-array N))) ; 隣接リスト
    (loop for i below N do (setf (aref tree i) nil))
    (loop repeat (1- N)
      do (let ((a (read))
               (b (read)))
           (push (1- b) (aref tree (1- a)))
           (push (1- a) (aref tree (1- b)))))
    tree))

(main)

; ならば, 自分はSに含まれる白頂点.
; 塗り分け方すべて: 2^N
; 自分が白: 2^(N - 1)
; (b) == not ((b1) or (b2))
; (b1) 隣接する部分グラフがすべて白: 1
; (b2) 隣接する部分グラフのちょうど一つGに黒が含まれる: 2^size(G) - 1
; 自分がSに含まれる白頂点である確率:
; (2^(N - 1) - 1 - sum_G (2^size(G) - 1))/2^N
; 全頂点の合計:
; (N * 2^(N - 1) - N - (sum_G 2^size(G)) + 2 * (N - 1))/2^N

(defun solve (N tree)
  (destructuring-bind
    ; 各頂点の親と各部分木の頂点数
    (parent subtree-size) (make-rooted-tree 0 tree)
    (let* ((subgraph-size ; 部分グラフの頂点数のリスト
             (loop for v below N append ; 各頂点
               (loop for next in (aref tree v) collect ; vの隣接頂点
                 ; nextの向こう側の部分グラフの頂点数
                 (if (eql next (aref parent v)) ; vの親?
                     (- N (aref subtree-size v))
                     (aref subtree-size next)))))
           (numerator (- (* N (1+ (ash 1 (1- N))))
                         (reduce #'+
                           (mapcar #'mod-expt-2
                             (normalize-exponents subgraph-size)))
                         2)))
    ; (2^N) * z == numerator mod *modulus* であるz
    ; *modulus*が素数なので 2^(*modulus* - 1) == 1 mod *modulus*
    (mod (* (mod numerator *modulus*) (mod-expt-2 (- *modulus* 1 N)))
         *modulus*))))

; 2, 2^100, 2^10000, 2^1000000 (mod *modulus*) のリスト
(defparameter *expt-2*
  (loop for n = 1 then (* n 100) while (< n *modulus*)
        collect (mod (ash 1 n) *modulus*)))

(defun mod-expt-2 (i)
  "(mod (expt 2 i) *modulus*)を少し速く計算"
  (mod (reduce #'*
         (loop for n = 1 then (* n 100)
               for x = i then (floor x 100) while (plusp x)
               for e in *expt-2*
               collect (expt e (mod x 100))))
       *modulus*))

(defun normalize-exponents (lst)
  "2の指数のリストを正規化"
  (setf lst (sort lst #'<))
  (labels ((normalizer (head n lst result)
             (cond ((and lst (eql (car lst) head))
                    (normalizer head (1+ n) (cdr lst) result))
                   ((>= n 2)
                    (normalizer (1+ head) (ash n -1) lst
                      (if (oddp n) (cons head result) result)))
                   (lst
                    (normalizer (car lst) 1 (cdr lst) (cons head result)))
                   (t (cons head result)))))
    (normalizer (car lst) 1 (cdr lst) ())))

(defun make-rooted-tree (root tree)
  "頂点rootを根としてtreeの各頂点の親を決める. 部分木の大きさも計算する."
  (let* ((N (array-dimension tree 0)) ; 頂点数
         (parent (make-array N :initial-element nil)) ; 親
         (subtree-size (make-array N :initial-element nil))) ; 部分木の頂点数
    (labels
      ((dfs (stack)
         (when stack
           (let ((v (pop stack)))
             (if (aref subtree-size v)
               ; 帰りがけ
               (loop for next in (aref tree v) ; vの隣接頂点
                 unless (eql next (aref parent v)) ; 親以外

                 initially (push v stack) ; 帰りがけ用に残す

                 for next in (aref tree v) ; vの隣接頂点
                 unless (eql next (aref parent v)) ; 親以外
                   do (push next stack)
                      (setf (aref parent next) v))))
           (dfs stack))))
      (dfs (list root))
      (list parent subtree-size))))

        (parent (make-array N :initial-element nil))
        (subtree-size (make-array N :initial-element nil))
        (sum-expt-2-subtree 0))
    ; 1, 2, 4, 8, ..., 2^(N - 1) をexpt-2に保存
    (loop for i below N for e = 1 then (mod (* e 2) *modulus*)
          do (setf (aref expt-2 i) e))

                  (p (aref parent v)) ; vの親

             (if (aref subtree-size v)
               ; 帰りがけ

                 (incf sum-expt-2-subtree (1- (aref expt-2 size)))
                 (incf sum-expt-2-subtree (1- (aref expt-2 (- N size))))

;; Blankinship algorithm
;; Reference: https://topcoder.g.hatena.ne.jp/spaghetti_source/20130126/1359171466 (Japanese)
(declaim (ftype (function * (values fixnum fixnum &optional)) %ext-gcd))
(defun %ext-gcd (a b)
  (declare (optimize (speed 3) (safety 0))
           (fixnum a b))
  (let ((y 1)
        (x 0)
        (u 1)
        (v 0))
    (declare (fixnum y x u v))
    (loop (when (zerop a)
            (return (values x y)))
          (let ((q (floor b a)))
            (decf x (the fixnum (* q u)))
            (rotatef x u)
            (decf y (the fixnum (* q v)))
            (rotatef y v)
            (decf b (the fixnum (* q a)))
            (rotatef b a)))))

(declaim (inline ext-gcd))
(defun ext-gcd (a b)
  "Returns two integers X and Y which satisfy AX + BY = gcd(A, B)."
  (declare ((integer #.(- most-positive-fixnum) #.most-positive-fixnum) a b))
  (if (>= a 0)
      (if (>= b 0)
          (%ext-gcd a b)
          (multiple-value-bind (x y) (%ext-gcd a (- b))
            (declare (fixnum x y))
            (values x (- y))))
      (if (>= b 0)
          (multiple-value-bind (x y) (%ext-gcd (- a) b)
            (declare (fixnum x y))
            (values (- x) y))
          (multiple-value-bind (x y) (%ext-gcd (- a) (- b))
            (declare (fixnum x y))
            (values (- x) (- y))))))

;; (defun mod-inverse (a modulus)

;;   (declare (integer a)

;;   (mod (%ext-gcd (mod a modulus) modulus) modulus))

(defun mod-inverse (a modulus)
  (declare ((integer 1 #.most-positive-fixnum) modulus))
  (let ((a (mod a modulus))
        (b modulus)
        (u 1)
        (v 0))
    (declare (fixnum a b u v))
    (loop until (zerop b)
          for quot = (floor a b)
          do (decf a (the fixnum (* quot b)))
             (rotatef a b)
             (decf u (the fixnum (* quot v)))
             (rotatef u v))
    (setq u (mod u modulus))
    (if (< u 0)
        (+ u modulus)
        u)))

  (declare (optimize (speed 3) (safety 0))

(defun mod-inverse (a modulus)
  (declare ((integer 1 #.most-positive-fixnum) modulus))
  (let ((a (mod a modulus))
        (b modulus)
        (u 1)
        (v 0))
    (declare (fixnum a b u v))
    (loop until (zerop b)

             (decf u (the fixnum (* quot v)))
             (rotatef u v))
    (setq u (mod u modulus))
    (if (< u 0)

def calc_fraction_mod(numerator, denominator):
    '''
        returns numerator / denominator (mod MOD)
    '''
    inv = pow(denominator, MOD - 2, MOD)
    return numerator * inv % MOD

def solve(N: int, A: "List[int]", B: "List[int]"):
    conns = [[] for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(N - 1):
        conns[A[i] - 1].append(B[i] - 1)
        conns[B[i] - 1].append(A[i] - 1)

    num = [0]
    visited = [False] * N
    def dfs(idx):
        visited[idx] = True
        children = 0
        subs = []
        for c in conns[idx]:
            if visited[c]:
                continue
            sub = dfs(c)
            children += sub
            subs.append(sub)
        subs.append(N - children - 1)
        tmp = pow(2, N - 1, MOD)
        tmp -= 1 # all white
        for sub in subs:
            tmp -= pow(2, sub, MOD) - 1
        num[0] += tmp
        return children + 1
    dfs(0)

    deno = pow(2, N, MOD)
    num = num[0]
    ret = calc_fraction_mod(num, deno)
    print(ret)
    return

def solve(N, AB):

    half = mod // 2 + 1
    G = [[0]*0 for _ in range(N+1)]
    for i in range(len(AB)):
        a, b = AB[i]
        G[a].append(b)
        G[b].append(a)
    P = [0] * (N+1)
    Size = [0] * (N+1)
    def dfs(v):
        # siz = 1

        #     if u != p:
        #         P[u] = v
        #         dfs(u)
        #         siz += Size[u]
        # Size[v] = siz
        st = [(v, 0)]
        while st:
            v, state = st.pop()
            p = P[v]
            if state == 0:
                st.append((v, 1))
                Size[v] = 1
                for u in G[v]:
                    if u != p:
                        P[u] = v
                        st.append((u, 0))
            else:
                Size[p] += Size[v]
    dfs(1)
    ans = 0
    Prob = [0]
    h = 1
    for i in range(202020):
        h = h * half % mod
        Prob.append(1-h)
    for v in range(1, len(G)):
        siz_v = Size[v]
        Gv = G[v]
        if v == 1:
            ps = [0]*0
        else:
            ps = [Prob[N-siz_v]]
        par = P[v]
        for u in Gv:
            if par != u:
                siz_u = Size[u]
                ps.append(Prob[siz_u])
        if len(ps)<=1:
            continue
        cumprod1_ps = [1, 1]
        cumprod2_ps = [1, 1]
        cp = 1
        for p in ps:
            cp = cp * (1-p) % mod
            cumprod1_ps.append(cp)
        cp = 1
        for p in ps[::-1]:
            cp = cp * (1-p) % mod
            cumprod2_ps.append(cp)
        cumprod2_ps.reverse()
        an = 1 - cumprod1_ps[-1]
        for j in range(1, len(cumprod1_ps)-1):
            cp1 = cumprod1_ps[j]
            cp2 = cumprod2_ps[j]
            p = ps[j-1]
            an -= cp1 * cp2 % mod * p
        ans += an
    ans = ans % mod * half % mod
    return ans

class rerooting:#全方位木
    def __init__(self,N,edge):#単位元self.unitとモノイドdef func,および親の追加処理def addnode設定すること
        #tot[親]:すべての子の値の累計
        #dics[親][根（親の隣接点)]=その部分木での値
        self.unit=0
        self.edge=edge
        self.par=[-1]*N
        self.N=N
        self.visited=[0]*N
        self.dics=[dict() for _ in range(N)]
        self.ikigake=[]
        self.tot=[self.unit]*N
        self._forward(0)
        

    def func(self,x,y):
        return x+y

    def addnode(self,x):#辺(距離)に関するdpのとき必要
        return x+1

    def _dfs(self,start):
        edge=self.edge
        N=self.N
        par=self.par
        q=deque([(start,start)])
        while len(q):
            e,pa=q.pop()#ここをpopleftにすると幅優先探索BFSになる
            if par[e]!=-1:continue
            par[e]=pa
            self.ikigake.append(e)
            for ne in edge[e]:q.append((ne,e))
        
        for e in reversed(self.ikigake[1:]):
            pa=par[e]
            ans=self.unit
            de=self.dics[e]
            for val in de.values():
                ans=self.func(ans,val)
            self.dics[pa][e]=self.addnode(ans)
    
    def _forward(self,start):
        self._dfs(start)
        for e in self.ikigake:
            pa=self.par[e]
            nes=list(self.dics[e].keys())
            nvals=list(self.dics[e].values())
            l=len(nes)
            aleft=[self.unit]
            aright=[self.unit]
            for i in range(l-1):
                aleft.append(self.func(aleft[-1],nvals[i]))
                aright.append(self.func(aright[-1],nvals[-i-1]))
            
            for i,ne in enumerate(nes):
                if ne==pa:
                    continue
                self.dics[ne][e]=self.addnode(self.func(aleft[i],aright[-1-i]))

            self.tot[e]=self.func(aright[-1],nvals[0])
        return self.dics

def solve(N, AB):
    mod = 10**9+7
    half = mod // 2 + 1
    G = [[0]*0 for _ in range(N+1)]
    for i in range(len(AB)):
        a, b = AB[i]
        G[a].append(b)
        G[b].append(a)
    P = np.zeros(N+1, dtype=np.int64)
    Size = np.zeros(N+1, dtype=np.int64)
    def dfs(v):
        # siz = 1

        #     if u != p:
        #         P[u] = v
        #         dfs(u)
        #         siz += Size[u]
        # Size[v] = siz
        st = [(v, 0)]
        while st:
            v, state = st.pop()
            p = P[v]
            if state == 0:
                st.append((v, 1))
                Size[v] = 1
                for u in G[v]:
                    if u != p:
                        P[u] = v
                        st.append((u, 0))
            else:
                Size[p] += Size[v]
    dfs(1)
    ans = 0
    Prob = np.empty(202020, dtype=np.int64)
    h = 1
    for i in range(202020):
        Prob[i] = 1-h+mod
        h = h * half % mod
    for v in range(1, len(G)):
        siz_v = Size[v]
        Gv = G[v]
        if v == 1:
            ps = [0]*0
        else:
            ps = [Prob[N-siz_v]]
        par = P[v]
        for u in Gv:
            if par != u:
                siz_u = Size[u]
                ps.append(Prob[siz_u])
        if len(ps)<=1:
            continue
        cumprod1_ps = [1, 1]
        cumprod2_ps = [1, 1]
        cp = 1
        for p in ps:
            cp = cp * (1-p+mod) % mod
            cumprod1_ps.append(cp)
        cp = 1
        for p in ps[::-1]:
            cp = cp * (1-p+mod) % mod
            cumprod2_ps.append(cp)
        cumprod2_ps.reverse()
        an = 1 - cumprod1_ps[-1]
        for j in range(1, len(cumprod1_ps)-1):
            cp1 = cumprod1_ps[j]
            cp2 = cumprod2_ps[j]
            p = ps[j-1]
            an -= cp1 * cp2 % mod * p % mod
        ans += an
    ans = ans % mod * half % mod
    return ans

from collections import deque

LARGE = 10 ** 9 + 7


def solve(n, a_list, b_list):
    # root at 0
    g = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n - 1):
        a = a_list[i] - 1
        b = b_list[i] - 1
        g[a].append(b)
        g[b].append(a)

    parent = [-1] * n
    children = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    depth = [0] * n

    # find parent
    queue = deque([0])
    while len(queue) > 0:
        p = queue.popleft()
        for q in g[p]:
            if q == parent[p]:
                continue
            parent[q] = p
            children[p].append(q)
            depth[q] = depth[p] + 1
            queue.append(q)

    # weight
    weight = [1] * n
    deeper = list(sorted([[i, depth[i]] for i in range(n)], key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
    for i, _ in deeper:
        for j in children[i]:
            weight[i] += weight[j]

    # calc
    res_array = [0] * n
    # P(i is not hole | i is white) = (other than one child( + parent) are all white)
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in children[i]:
            res_array[n - 1 - weight[j]] += 1
        res_array[weight[i] - 1] += 1
        res_array[n - 1] -= len(children[i])
    for j in children[0]:
        res_array[n - 1 - weight[j]] += 1
    res_array[n - 1] -= len(children[0]) - 1
    # print(res_array)

    res_a = pow(2, n - 1, LARGE) * n
    res_a %= LARGE
    # print(res_a)
    for i in range(n):
        res_a -= pow(2, n - i - 1, LARGE) * res_array[i]
        res_a %= LARGE
        # print(res_a)
    res_b = pow(2, n, LARGE)

    res = res_a * pow(res_b, LARGE - 2, LARGE) % LARGE
    # print(res_a, res_b)
    return res

        a_list[i] = a

def ext_euc(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        return 1, 0, a
    y, x, v = ext_euc(b, a % b)
    y -= (a // b) * x
    return x, y, v


def mod_inv(a, mod):
    x, _, _ = ext_euc(a, mod)
    return x % mod


def main():
    MOD = 10 ** 9 + 7
    N = int(input())
    adj = defaultdict(list)
    for _ in range(N - 1):
        A, B = list(map(lambda x: int(x) - 1, input().split()))
        adj[A].append(B)
        adj[B].append(A)

    # 2 ** n の事前計算
    pow_2 = [1 for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        pow_2[i] = pow_2[i - 1] * 2 % MOD

    # 分子：sum_{i} (node i が穴あき度の値としてカウント対象になるような塗り方)
    # node_num[(node, dir_node)]: nodeから見てdir_node方向に存在するノードの数
    #         5               6
    #        (6)             (6)
    #         |               |
    #        (1)             (1)
    # 0(6)-(1)1(4)-(3)2(3)-(4)3(1)-(6)4
    node_num = defaultdict(int)

    def dfs(node=0, parent=None):
        child_list = [n for n in adj[node] if n != parent]
        if len(child_list) == 0:
            node_num[(node, parent)] = N - 1
            node_num[(parent, node)] = 1
            return 1
        n_descendant = 1  # self
        for child in child_list:
            n_descendant += dfs(child, node)
        if parent is not None:
            node_num[(node, parent)] = N - n_descendant
            node_num[(parent, node)] = n_descendant
        return n_descendant

    dfs()

    numer = 0
    for node in range(N):
        if len(adj[node]) <= 1:
            # 端（次数1）のノードはカウント対象にならない
            continue
        cnt_not = 0  # node が穴あき度の値としてカウントされないケース
        for dir_node in adj[node]:
            # dir_node方向のノードは自由、それ以外の方向のノードは全部白
            cnt_not += pow_2[node_num[(node, dir_node)]]
        cnt_not -= len(adj[node]) - 1  # 「全部白塗り」の重複カウントを除去
        numer += pow_2[N - 1] - cnt_not  # node自身は白でないとカウントされないので、全体のパターン数が2 ** (N-1)

    # 分母：2 ** N （全部の塗り方）
    denom = pow_2[N]

    # 答え
    print(numer * mod_inv(denom, MOD) % MOD)

"""
ある頂点が白のとき，穴あき度の総和に与える影響を考える，
入力例2の1-2-3-4なら(0,3,3,0)この頂点2に注目，この3は，上下どちらもに黒があれば良い．上(2^1 - 1) * 下(2^2 - 1)=3．つまり全量 - all白

実際には子が多い．どこか2箇所の部分木に黒があれば良い=>余事象．
・全量：pow(2,N-1)，自分は白確定，墓はなんでも良い

・all白=1通り
・1個の部分木が黒*1通り（*1は残りall白の分）
「1この部分木が黒」はどう求める？　その部分木のサイズをnとして，2^n - 1．
その部分木のサイズはどう求める？　全方位木DPか=>端の頂点から詰めていけばいけそう

"""

def main():
    mod=10**9+7
    import queue
        
    N=I()
    adj=[[]for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(N-1):
        x,y=MI()
        x-=1
        y-=1
        adj[x].append(y)
        adj[y].append(x)
        
    #2べきを持っておくか，
    POW=[1]
    for _ in range(N+5):
        temp=POW[-1]
        POW.append((temp*2)%mod)
    
    L=[[]for _ in range(N)]#　各頂点からみて，個を根とする部分木のサイズを配列として持っておく    
    
    looked=[0]*N#qに突っ込むか
    used=[0]*N#計算を終えたか
    q=queue.Queue()
    
    for v in range(N):
        if len(adj[v])==1:
            q.put(v)
            L[v].append(0)
            looked[v]=1
            
    ans=[0]*N
    while not q.empty():
        v=q.get()
        S=sum(L[v])
        rem=N-S-1#まだ見ていない方向の合計
        temp=POW[N-1]#全体
        temp-=1#all白
        
        for s in L[v]:#1つの部分木にだけ黒があるパターンを引く
            temp-=POW[s]-1
            temp%=mod
            
        if rem!=0:
            temp-=POW[rem]-1
            temp%=mod
            
        ans[v]=temp
        
        for nv in adj[v]:
            if looked[nv]==0:
                q.put(nv)
                looked[nv]=1
            if used[nv]==0:
                L[nv].append(S+1)
                
                
    # print(ans)
    y=sum(ans)
    x=POW[N]
    
    res=(y*pow(x,mod-2,mod))%mod
    print(res)

def main():
    MOD = 1000000007
    N, *AB = map(int, read().split())
    G = [[] for _ in range(N)]
    for a, b in zip(AB[::2], AB[1::2]):
        G[a - 1].append(b - 1)
        G[b - 1].append(a - 1)

    stack = deque([0])
    order = []
    prev = [0] * N
    prev[0] = -1
    while stack:
        v = stack.pop()
        order.append(v)
        for nv in G[v]:
            if nv != prev[v]:
                stack.append(nv)
                prev[nv] = v

    pow2 = [0] * (N + 1)
    pow2[0] = 1
    for i in range(N):
        pow2[i + 1] = pow2[i] * 2 % MOD

    nodes = [1] * N
    numer = 0

    for v in reversed(order):
        if prev[v] != -1:
            nodes[prev[v]] += nodes[v]
        numer = (numer + pow2[N - 1] - 1 - (pow2[N - nodes[v]] - 1)) % MOD
        for nv in G[v]:
            if nv != prev[v]:
                numer = (numer - (pow2[nodes[nv]] - 1)) % MOD

    denom = pow2[N]
    ans = (numer * pow(denom, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD
    print(ans)

def my_pow(base, n, mod):
    if n == 0:
        return 1
    x = base
    y = 1
    while n > 1:
        if n % 2 == 0:
            x *= x
            n //= 2
        else:
            y *= x
            n -= 1
        x %= mod
        y %= mod
    return x * y % mod

        v, pc = q.pop()

        if len(subtree_count[v]) == 0:

def dfs1(root, links):
    parent = [0] * n
    subtree_count = [{} for _ in range(n)]
    q = [(root, -1, 0)]  # 2番目:親  3番目:0=初, 1=全ての子巡回後
    while q:
        v, p, t = q.pop()
        if t == 0:
            parent[v] = p
            q.append((v, p, 1))
            for u in links[v]:
                if u == p:
                    continue
                q.append((u, v, 0))
        elif p != -1:
            subtree_count[p][v] = sum(subtree_count[v].values()) + 1
    return parent, subtree_count


def dfs2(root, parent, subtree_count, d2, d2s):
    ans = 0
    q = [(root, 0)]
    while q:
        v, pc = q.pop()

        if len(subtree_count[v]) == 0:
            continue

        p = parent[v]
        children, st_counts = map(list, zip(*subtree_count[v].items()))
        children.append(p)
        st_counts.append(pc)
        cl = len(st_counts)
        ct = sum(st_counts)

        for u, stc in subtree_count[v].items():
            q.append((u, ct - stc + 1))

        if cl == 1:
            continue

        tmp = 0
        for stc in st_counts:
            tmp = (tmp + d2s[ct - stc]) % MOD
        tmp = (tmp - d2s[ct] * (cl - 1)) % MOD
        ans = (ans + (1 - tmp) * d2) % MOD
    return ans

read = sys.stdin.buffer.read


def main():
    MOD = 1000000007
    N, *AB = map(int, read().split())
    G = [[] for _ in range(N)]
    for a, b in zip(AB[::2], AB[1::2]):
        G[a - 1].append(b - 1)
        G[b - 1].append(a - 1)

    stack = deque([0])
    order = []
    prev = [0] * N
    prev[0] = -1
    while stack:
        v = stack.pop()
        order.append(v)
        for nv in G[v]:
            if nv != prev[v]:
                stack.append(nv)
                prev[nv] = v

    pow2 = [0] * (N + 1)
    pow2[0] = 1
    for i in range(N):
        pow2[i + 1] = pow2[i] * 2 % MOD

    nodes = [1] * N
    numer = 0

    for v in reversed(order):
        if prev[v] != -1:
            nodes[prev[v]] += nodes[v]
        numer = (numer + pow2[N - 1] - pow2[N - nodes[v]]) % MOD
        for nv in G[v]:
            if nv != prev[v]:
                numer = (numer - pow2[nodes[nv]] + 1) % MOD

    denom = pow2[N]
    ans = (numer * pow(denom, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD
    print(ans)

@lru_cache(maxsize=10**6)
def dfs(s, p=-1):
    sub_tree = []
    res = 1
    for t in edge[s]:
        if t == p:
            continue
        size = dfs(t, s)
        sub_tree.append(size)
        res += size
    if N != res:
        sub_tree.append(N - res)

class rerooting:#全方位木
    def __init__(self,N,edge):#単位元self.unitとモノイドdef func,および親の追加処理def addnode設定すること
        #tot[親]:すべての子の値の累計
        #dics[親][根（親の隣接点)]=その部分木での値
        self.unit=0
        self.edge=edge
        self.par=[-1]*N
        self.N=N
        self.visited=[0]*N
        self.dics=[dict() for _ in range(N)]
        self.ikigake=[]
        self.tot=[self.unit]*N
        self._forward(0)
        

    def func(self,x,y):
        return x+y

    def addnode(self,x):#辺(距離)に関するdpのとき必要
        return x+1

    def _dfs(self,start):
        edge=self.edge
        N=self.N
        par=self.par
        q=deque([(start,start)])
        while len(q):
            e,pa=q.pop()#ここをpopleftにすると幅優先探索BFSになる
            if par[e]!=-1:continue
            par[e]=pa
            self.ikigake.append(e)
            for ne in edge[e]:q.append((ne,e))
        
        for e in reversed(self.ikigake[1:]):
            pa=par[e]
            ans=self.unit
            de=self.dics[e]
            for val in de.values():
                ans=self.func(ans,val)
            self.dics[pa][e]=self.addnode(ans)
    
    def _forward(self,start):
        self._dfs(start)
        for e in self.ikigake:
            pa=self.par[e]
            nes=list(self.dics[e].keys())
            nvals=list(self.dics[e].values())
            l=len(nes)
            aleft=[self.unit]
            aright=[self.unit]
            for i in range(l-1):
                aleft.append(self.func(aleft[-1],nvals[i]))
                aright.append(self.func(aright[-1],nvals[-i-1]))
            
            for i,ne in enumerate(nes):
                if ne==pa:
                    continue
                self.dics[ne][e]=self.addnode(self.func(aleft[i],aright[-1-i]))

            self.tot[e]=self.func(aright[-1],nvals[0])
        return self.dics

def solve(N, AB):
    mod = 10**9+7
    half = mod // 2 + 1
    G = [[0]*0 for _ in range(N+1)]
    for i in range(len(AB)):
        a, b = AB[i]
        G[a].append(b)
        G[b].append(a)
    P = [0] * (N+1)
    Size = [0] * (N+1)
    def dfs(v):
        # siz = 1
        # p = P[v]
        # for u in G[v]:
        #     if u != p:
        #         P[u] = v
        #         dfs(u)
        #         siz += Size[u]
        # Size[v] = siz
        st = [(v, 0)]
        while st:
            v, state = st.pop()
            p = P[v]
            if state == 0:
                st.append((v, 1))
                Size[v] = 1
                for u in G[v]:
                    if u != p:
                        P[u] = v
                        st.append((u, 0))
            else:
                Size[p] += Size[v]
    dfs(1)
    ans = 0
    Prob = [0]
    h = 1
    for i in range(202020):
        h = h * half % mod
        Prob.append(1-h)
    for v in range(1, len(G)):
        siz_v = Size[v]
        Gv = G[v]
        if v == 1:
            ps = [0]*0
        else:
            ps = [Prob[N-siz_v]]
        par = P[v]
        for u in Gv:
            if par != u:
                siz_u = Size[u]
                ps.append(Prob[siz_u])
        if len(ps)<=1:
            continue
        cumprod1_ps = [1, 1]
        cumprod2_ps = [1, 1]
        cp = 1
        for p in ps:
            cp = cp * (1-p) % mod
            cumprod1_ps.append(cp)
        cp = 1
        for p in ps[::-1]:
            cp = cp * (1-p) % mod
            cumprod2_ps.append(cp)
        cumprod2_ps.reverse()
        an = 1 - cumprod1_ps[-1]
        for j in range(1, len(cumprod1_ps)-1):
            cp1 = cumprod1_ps[j]
            cp2 = cumprod2_ps[j]
            p = ps[j-1]
            an -= cp1 * cp2 % mod * p
        ans += an
    ans = ans % mod * half % mod
    return ans

class Tree():
    def __init__(self, n, edge, indexed=1):
        self.n = n
        self.tree = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for e in edge:
            self.tree[e[0] - indexed].append(e[1] - indexed)
            self.tree[e[1] - indexed].append(e[0] - indexed)

    def setroot(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.parent = [None for _ in range(self.n)]
        self.parent[root] = -1
        self.depth = [None for _ in range(self.n)]
        self.depth[root] = 0
        self.order = []
        self.order.append(root)
        self.size = [1 for _ in range(self.n)]
        stack = [root]
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            for adj in self.tree[node]:
                if self.parent[adj] is None:
                    self.parent[adj] = node
                    self.depth[adj] = self.depth[node] + 1
                    self.order.append(adj)
                    stack.append(adj)
        for node in self.order[::-1]:
            for adj in self.tree[node]:
                if self.parent[node] == adj:
                    continue
                self.size[node] += self.size[adj]

def my_pow(base, n, mod):
    if n == 0:
        return 1
    x = base
    y = 1
    while n > 1:
        if n % 2 == 0:
            x *= x
            n //= 2
        else:
            y *= x

        x %= mod
        y %= mod
    return x * y % mod

def topological_sort_tree(tree: list, root) -> list:
    """根付き木をトポロジカルソートする"""
    n = len(tree)
    ans = [root]
    visited = [False] * n
    visited[root] = True
    q = deque([root])
    while q:
        par = q.popleft()
        for child in tree[par]:
            if visited[child]:
                continue
            visited[child] = True
            q.append(child)
            ans.append(child)
    return ans

    base = counts[node]

    for v in paths:

        result -= pow(2, count, mod) - 1
        result %= mod

    while stack:
        p = stack.pop()

            stack.append(~p)

                    Par[np] = p

            ans = (ans + score) % mod
            Childs[Par[p]].append(N-1-upper+1)

    while stack: 
        node = stack.pop()
        order.append(node)
        for child in graph[node]:
            if parent[node] == child:
                continue
            parent[child] = node
            stack.append(child)
    # これで各頂点の親情報とおとづれた順番がわかった

    pow_inv = [1]*(N+1) # 2^NをO(1)でとってこれるようにあらかじめ計算しておく

    r = [1,0,a]

class rerooting:#全方位木
    def __init__(self,N,edge):#単位元self.unitとモノイドdef func,および親の追加処理def addnode設定すること
        #tot[親]:すべての子の値の累計
        #dics[親][根（親の隣接点)]=その部分木での値
        self.unit=0
        self.edge=edge
        self.par=[-1]*N
        self.N=N
        self.visited=[0]*N
        self.dics=[dict() for _ in range(N)]
        self.ikigake=[]
        self.tot=[self.unit]*N
        self._forward(0)
        

    def func(self,x,y):
        return x+y

    def addnode(self,x):#辺(距離)に関するdpのとき必要
        return x+1

    def _dfs(self,start):
        edge=self.edge
        N=self.N
        par=self.par
        q=deque([(start,start)])
        while len(q):
            e,pa=q.pop()#ここをpopleftにすると幅優先探索BFSになる
            if par[e]!=-1:continue
            par[e]=pa
            self.ikigake.append(e)
            for ne in edge[e]:q.append((ne,e))
        
        for e in reversed(self.ikigake[1:]):
            pa=par[e]
            ans=self.unit
            de=self.dics[e]
            for val in de.values():
                ans=self.func(ans,val)
            self.dics[pa][e]=self.addnode(ans)
    
    def _forward(self,start):
        self._dfs(start)
        for e in self.ikigake:
            pa=self.par[e]
            nes=list(self.dics[e].keys())
            nvals=list(self.dics[e].values())
            l=len(nes)
            aleft=[self.unit]
            aright=[self.unit]
            for i in range(l-1):
                aleft.append(self.func(aleft[-1],nvals[i]))
                aright.append(self.func(aright[-1],nvals[-i-1]))
            
            for i,ne in enumerate(nes):
                if ne==pa:
                    continue
                self.dics[ne][e]=self.addnode(self.func(aleft[i],aright[-1-i]))

            self.tot[e]=self.func(aright[-1],nvals[0])
        return self.dics

LARGE = 10 ** 9 + 7


def solve(n, a_list, b_list):
    # root at 0
    g = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n - 1):
        a = a_list[i] - 1
        b = b_list[i] - 1
        g[a].append(b)
        g[b].append(a)

    parent = [-1] * n
    children = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    depth = [0] * n

    # find parent
    queue = deque([0])
    while len(queue) > 0:
        p = queue.popleft()
        for q in g[p]:
            if q == parent[p]:
                continue
            parent[q] = p
            children[p].append(q)
            depth[q] = depth[p] + 1
            queue.append(q)

    # weight
    weight = [1] * n
    deeper = list(sorted([[i, depth[i]] for i in range(n)], key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True))
    for i, _ in deeper:
        for j in children[i]:
            weight[i] += weight[j]

    # calc
    res_array = [0] * n
    # P(i is not hole | i is white) = (other than one child( + parent) are all white)
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in children[i]:
            res_array[n - 1 - weight[j]] += 1
        res_array[weight[i] - 1] += 1
        res_array[n - 1] -= len(children[i])
    for j in children[0]:
        res_array[n - 1 - weight[j]] += 1
    res_array[n - 1] -= len(children[0]) - 1
    # print(res_array)

    res_a = pow(2, n - 1, LARGE) * n
    res_a %= LARGE
    # print(res_a)
    for i in range(n):
        res_a -= pow(2, n - i - 1, LARGE) * res_array[i]
        res_a %= LARGE
        # print(res_a)
    res_b = pow(2, n, LARGE)

    res = res_a * pow(res_b, LARGE - 2, LARGE) % LARGE
    # print(res_a, res_b)
    return res

AB = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N-1)]
G = [[] for _ in range(N)]
for i, (a, b) in enumerate(AB):
    a -= 1
    b -= 1
    G[a].append((b, i))
    G[b].append((a, i))

P = [0] * N
visited = [False] * N
visited[0] = True
def dfs(x, i):
    e = 1
    for v, c in G[x]:
        if not visited[v]:
            visited[v] = True
            e += dfs(v, c)
    P[i] = e
    return e

dfs(0, -1)
W = [1] * (N + 1)
inv_2 = pow(2, MOD-2, MOD)
for i in range(N):
    W[i+1] = W[i]*inv_2%MOD
ans = (W[N] + 1) * (N - 1) % MOD
for i in range(N-1):
    ans -= W[P[i]] + W[N-P[i]]
    ans %= MOD
print((ans - inv_2*N - W[N] + 1) % MOD)

def RD(): return sys.stdin.read()

def main():
	mod=10**9+7
	n=II()
	G=[[] for _ in range(n+1)]
	e=[]
	v=[0]*(n+1)
	p=[0]*(n+1)

	for _ in range(n-1):
		a,b=MI()
		G[a].append(b)
		G[b].append(a)
		e.append([a,b,0])

	@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
	def tree(a):
		cnt=1
		for i in G[a]:
			if p[a]==i:
				continue
			else:
				p[i]=a
				cnt+=tree(i)
		v[a]=cnt
		return cnt
	tree(1)
	#print(v)

	for i in range(n-1):
		#print(e[i])
		a=e[i][0]
		b=e[i][1]
		e[i][2]=min(v[a],v[b])
	#print(e)

	ex=0

	for _,_,c in e:
		ex+=(1-0.5**c)*(1-0.5**(n-c))
	ex+=1-0.5**n-n/2
	ex=int(ex*2**n+0.5)
	#print(ex)

	for i in range(1,n+1):
		if ex%2==0:
			ex//=2
		else:
			i-=1
			break
	y=ex
	x=2**(n-i)
	#print(y,x)

	y%=mod
	x%=mod

	ans=y*pow(x,mod-2,mod)%mod

	print(ans)


if __name__ == "__main__":
	main()
